subject.title: Session reset on abort settle timeout causes complete context loss (session amnesia)

question: What context, if any, may OpenClaw carry from a reset/taken-over embedded session into its replacement after provider-error abort settlement?
rationale: The useful fix is not just mechanical: replaying prior transcript or trajectory data can solve user-visible amnesia, but it can also cross auth, channel, thread, clean-reset, or session-isolation boundaries if the policy is wrong.

options.title: Bounded same-session recovery
options.body: Allow a small user/assistant context bridge only when the previous and replacement sessions share the same sessionKey, channel/thread/auth scope, and reset reason is internal recovery.

options.title: Takeover recovery only
options.body: Land or revise the related takeover PR for resend/message-loss behavior, but do not automatically replay context until a separate security design is approved.

options.title: No automatic carry-forward
options.body: Keep reset as a hard boundary and rely on user-visible diagnostics/exported trajectory for recovery, accepting that this issue remains a product limitation.

recommendation.title: Bounded same-session recovery
recommendation.body: Allow a small user/assistant context bridge only when the previous and replacement sessions share the same sessionKey, channel/thread/auth scope, and reset reason is internal recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent session-lock recovery work plus security-sensitive product-boundary judgment makes this the best available routing candidate from the history inspected.
